description: In server.rs route_method Email/query, when no target_group is found (inMailbox does not match any known group), the response is: json!({"ids": [], "total": 0, "queryState": email_state, "canCalculateChanges": false, "position": 0}). The RFC 8620 §5.5 QueryResponse MUST include accountId. The response constructed here omits it, which is a protocol violation. Clients relying on accountId in the response will misbehave.
title: Email/query returns no accountId when mailbox not found
